head_neck.label: Continuous oral treatment

medicines.name: Antiemetic plan for current oral dose
medicines.note: Review QT prolongation and all interactions; no automatic IV chemotherapy script.

additional_support: Take with water, without food or with a low- or moderate-fat meal. For a high-fat meal, take sorafenib at least 1 hour before or 2 hours afterwards. Follow the prescribed morning and evening doses; never change the dose yourself.

Consider blood count, kidney and liver tests at Day 14 of the first month. Repeat these bloods and thyroid tests every 28 days. Check blood pressure weekly in month 1, then every 28 days; check INR as indicated if taking warfarin.
Tell the team before surgery or dental procedures. Report painful palms or soles early; skin care and early dose review can help prevent severe hand-foot reactions.
head_neck.prescription_note: Review allergies, interactions, doses and timing; no administration authority.
